g.text: 16 pleats, folds toward the side seams both sides of CF / CB · face 6.75 · depth 3 · edge-stitched 37 cm
① section through the pleat seam level (seen from below, schematic: layers spread apart)
to the wearer's LEFT side seam
to the wearer's RIGHT side seam
Fold edges point to the nearest side seam on both sides of CF (and of CB). Face ≈ 6.75 cm, depth 3 cm → intake 6 cm per pleat, 96 cm in all;
the underlays do not overlap (PD < PF): ≈ 1.89 layers under the seam. Panel cut ≈ 224 cm round (4 quarter pieces, joins hidden in a pleat inner fold / in the side seam).
② plan at the pleat seam (wearer's left front, 4 pleats) · edge-stitched the full 37 cm
edge-stitch 1.5 mm from the fold, FULL LENGTH, leather thread
fold edge → toward the side seam
pleat seam, topstitch 6 mm on the upper body
Level all round at PS = 33 cm below HPS · skived, glued up · topstitched 6 mm · placket crosses it
pleated panel (pleat folds skived at the seam)
allowances skived + graded, glued UP, no binding
placket (separate lambskin strip, plain indigo) crosses the pleat seam
15 mm snap, ≥ 4 cm from the seam
colour on the pleat faces only (pleats taped shut while colouring)
Point collar on a stand · interfaced · stand snap
N2 46 cm along the neck seam (stand, end to end)
stand snap 12.5 mm (cap on the wearer's left end)
leather fusible ≤ 80 °C in stand + collar (fused after colouring)
Point collar on a stand: collar point NP 7.5 cm, stand 3.5 cm at CB. Upper + under collar in lambskin, allowances skived, both interfaced; stand + collar edge-stitched 1.5 mm. Never coloured.
Cap + socket on the top placket · stud + post on the under placket
CAP Ø 15 mm (outside, top placket) + prong ring
8 sets: stand 1 (12.5 mm), placket 5 (15 mm) at S1 = 14 cm below HPS then every SN = 12.5 cm, cuffs 2 (15 mm). Set AFTER colouring,
top coat and sewing, through 2–3 plies of lambskin + fusible; leather-length post (2–4 mm). Leather patch + fusible behind every snap.
Nickel-free; open / close force 15–30 N; pull ≥ 90 N.
Two-piece 6 cm lambskin cuff · 1 snap · tower placket · 2 pleats
tower placket 14 cm (back of the sleeve)
cuff snap 15 mm, cap on the overlap
Two-piece lambskin cuff, edges turned and glued, leather fusible on the outer, edge-stitched 1.5 mm all round. CW = 12.5 cm closed (cuff − wrist ≈ 8 cm, an overshirt cuff).
Glued open + topstitched · lambskin / cupro yoke · hem turned 2 cm before pleating
① plain seam, glued open, topstitched (armhole, side, sleeve)
② yoke: lambskin outer + cupro inner
inner yoke in cupro (main label here)
Upper body + sleeves half-lined in cupro (covers the glued seams); the pleated lower half is unlined. Skin joins hidden in a pleat under-fold. No steam, cool press through paper only.
